_why: D-43a baseline. Every moat block listed here declares sources but not roles. The judgement of what each source actually does - a rent with an end date, or a barrier that stops a rival - has not been made for these yet. The list may only shrink: a block that acquires roles must be removed from it, and a new block may not be added without one. Generated 14 Sep 2026 when D-43a was ratified and Denali was declared.
_comment: 14 Oct 2026 (step 3): CSL's three segment moat blocks declare D-43a roles (collection network, manufacturing complexity, regulatory, commercial scale = barrier; plasma supply and real-world data = rent; patent LCM = both).
_comment_wbc: 14 Oct 2026 (D-77): WBC's four segment moat blocks declare D-43a roles (scale, switching_cost, regulatory = barrier; distribution = both; relationship = rent). The list is now empty.
